name: Hoshizora ☆ Planet
source: It's been seven years since you left your sweet hometown. You are back, and you meet up with old friends that have all grown up beautifully. Enjoying this reunion, something triggers your mind to recall a tragic memory that happened seven years ago...
translation: 你离开温馨的故乡已经七年。如今终于归来，与昔日好友重逢；他们都已出落得十分优秀。正享受重逢的喜悦时，某件事触动了你的记忆，使你回想起七年前发生的悲剧……
